## F20.update-mechanism — Update mechanism

Definition: How the product updates itself or is updated.
- claude-code [supported, verified] Claude Code auto-updates and can also be updated with claude update: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER stops only background updates while claude update still works, and DISABLE_UPDATES is for when laptops must not fetch releases. minimumVersion prevents auto-update from installing below an org-wide minimum. Version checks and downloads go directly to Anthropic, separate from the gateway path. | ev: E-claude-code-06567, E-claude-code-00138, E-claude-code-09325
